Title: Pricing — Prism

MONTHLY PLANS

# Pick your plan.
Prices are shown in your local currency, with tax where it applies. Creator and Studio start with a 7-day free trial.

ABOUT PLANS

### Good to know.

**Is there a free trial?**
Creator and Studio start with a 7-day free trial. You add a payment method at checkout and aren’t charged until the trial ends; cancel before then and you pay nothing. The Trial plan is $9 a month from the start.

**How do I cancel?**
Anytime, in a few clicks: open your dashboard, choose Manage billing and cancel your plan. It stays active until the end of the period you’ve paid for.

**Which platforms does Prism run on?**
Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit), macOS 14 or later on Apple Silicon, and Linux (x86_64 with GTK 4).

**Which languages do captions support?**
Prism transcribes speech and writes captions in the language spoken in your video. Automatic filler-word cleanup currently works for English only.

URL: https://prismclips.app/faq
Title: Help & FAQs — Prism

A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

# A little clarity. Then, create.
Everything to know before your first Short.

**How much does Prism cost?**
There are three monthly plans: Trial ($9), Creator ($39) and Studio ($149), shown in your local currency. Creator and Studio start with a 7-day free trial, AI processing is included, and you can cancel anytime. See the plans.

**What happens to my footage?**
Your source files, projects, preview, and rendering stay on your computer. Audio chunks, transcripts, sampled frames, and editor chat messages are sent to Google for AI processing. Prism needs an internet connection; it has no offline AI mode.

**Can I change the Shorts Prism picks?**
Yes. Review and adjust every Short before export. Change the timing, choose Fill, Fit, or Split framing, try seven caption styles, or ask the editor chat to help with edits.

**Where can I post my exports?**
Prism exports vertical MP4 files at up to 1080 × 1920. Upload them yourself to your favorite short-form platforms, including YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and TikTok. Direct publishing isn’t built in.

**Is this ready for my daily workflow?**
Prism is an early beta. The Mac pipeline works end to end, but you should review every clip and expect rough edges. Windows and Linux ports are available but still need verification on real devices. Read the current limits.

**Do I need a Prism account?**
Yes. Your plan belongs to your Prism account, so you need one to subscribe. Sign in to the app with the same account. Your dashboard also shows your export stats and history. Create an account.

**How do I get started?**
Download Prism for your platform, sign in with your Prism account, and import a video. See the three-step workflow for a quick tour.

### Something else on your mind?
Check the project documentation ↗ or share your feedback on GitHub ↗.

URL: https://prismclips.app/about
Title: About — Prism

ABOUT PRISM

# One video in. Many Shorts out.
Prism is a desktop app that turns long videos into vertical Shorts with captions.

### What Prism does
Import a podcast, lecture, interview or stream. Prism transcribes it, finds moments that stand on their own, and cuts them into vertical Shorts. It reframes each one for the small screen and adds captions in the language spoken in your video. You review every Short and make the final cut before you export.

### Who it’s for
Creators, podcasters and streamers who want more short-form videos from the long recordings they already make, without spending hours in an editor.

### Where it runs
Prism runs on your computer: Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit), macOS 14 or later on Apple Silicon, and Linux (x86_64 with GTK 4). Your source files and finished videos stay on your machine. See Privacy for what is sent for AI processing.

### Plans
Three monthly plans: Trial ($9), Creator ($39) and Studio ($149), shown in your local currency. Creator and Studio start with a 7-day free trial. AI processing is included, and you can cancel anytime. Compare plans.

### Learn more
See features, how it works and the FAQs, or download Prism.

2026-10-21 · BETA

#### New

- Installers for macOS (.dmg), Windows (.exe) and Linux (.AppImage), built on every release tag.

- Native Windows and Linux workspaces on a shared engine. Both are untested on real devices.

#### Fixed

- Gemini timeouts now fail the run instead of silently dropping results.

- Crops stay inside frames with odd pixel sizes.

- macOS release builds with the newest Xcode and its own SQLite.

### Earlier builds

- First Prism video-to-Shorts editor for Mac.

- Gemini became the only AI pipeline for picking Shorts and framing.

- Better Shorts selection, caption customization and editing.

- Shared rendering engine with tests.

URL: https://prismclips.app/privacy
Title: Privacy — Prism

PRIVACY

# Your footage stays yours.
Plain-language summary of where your data goes. Last updated 2026-10-22.

### On your computer

- Your source video files. Prism copies them into a project and never changes the originals.

- Projects, previews and rendered MP4s.

- Your Gemini API key. On Mac it is stored in the Keychain, never in projects or preferences.

### Sent to Google
Prism has no offline mode. Every AI step runs on Google’s Gemini API, so Google’s terms and privacy policy apply to this data:

- Audio chunks of the part of the video you selected.

- Transcripts.

- Sampled frames: up to 12 per refinement batch, and about 1 per second of each tracked Short.

- Editor chat messages, with recent conversation and a short edit summary.
Temporary audio files are deleted after each request. See Google’s Privacy Policy and the Gemini API terms.

### Your Prism account
Your Prism account is stored with our database provider, Supabase. Payments are handled by Paddle, our reseller; Prism never sees your card details. The account stores:

- Your email address and password. The password is stored hashed by Supabase Auth.

- Your plan’s Paddle subscription and customer IDs, status and next billing date.

- One record per finished export from the Mac app: the date, number of Shorts, total length in seconds and export quality.
No video, audio, transcripts or titles are sent to your account. Database rules let each user read only their own records. Deleting your account deletes its export records.

### Questions or deletion requests
Open an issue on GitHub to ask a question or to have your account deleted.

This page describes how the software works. It is not legal advice.

Title: Terms — Prism

TERMS

# Terms of use
The short version: Prism is beta software, provided as is. Last updated 2026-10-22.

### The software
Prism is provided “as is”, without warranty of any kind.

### Beta status
Prism is early beta software. Review every Short before you publish it, and keep your own backups. The Windows and Linux versions have not been tested on real devices yet.

### Your content
You keep all rights to your videos and exports. You are responsible for having the rights to the footage you process and the Shorts you publish.

### Gemini
Prism sends audio, transcripts and sampled frames to Google’s Gemini API for AI processing. That processing is covered by Google’s Gemini API terms.

### Your account
Keep your password safe and don’t use the account to break the service or access other people’s data. Accounts may be removed if they are abused. See the Privacy page for what the account stores.

### Changes
These terms may change as Prism grows. The date at the top shows the latest version.

This is a plain-language draft, not legal advice.
